caption: New wind-combed procedural grass meadow at noon in Harrowmere Vale; bare ground between clumps is still flat grey-brown and the distant hills float as disconnected ribbons in the fog.
Grass on a Vale slope at 16:30 golden hour reads well up close, but past the 64 m grass radius the valley is an empty brown plane under grey sky with no trees, rocks or village.
Noon in Harrowmere Vale: the hill bowl finally renders solid behind the wind-combed meadow (terrain winding fix); still no trees, rocks, village or textures, and the capsule player is a speck.
16:30: long hill shadows sweep across the valley, but the shadowed foreground is crushed to black and the sky is flat grey.
22:30: new moonlight and star field make the night readable on wind-bent grass; no moon disc, fireflies or night life yet.
New procedural black-oak grove backlit at 15:30 with long trunk shadows through the grass; foreground shadow is crushed to black and leaf cards read as blobs up close.
Oak woodland now crowns the vale's hills above the wind-blown meadow at noon; boulders are too small to read, sky is flat and the hill ground is still bare procedural brown.
Backlit oak grove at 15:30: the shadowed grass and trunks now read with cool skylight instead of crushing to black; leaf cards still look like flat blobs up close.
Noon meadow and oak-crowned hills: shade under the grass is readable now; boulders are too small, hill ground is bare procedural brown.
Village edge at 16:30, previously half black: the shadowed meadow is now visible, but the sky is too dark navy for late afternoon and the horizon is empty.
16:30 over the village meadow: the sky is now a deep clear blue instead of navy and the shaded meadow reads; a tree trunk still blocks the left edge and the hills are bare procedural orange.
Noon oak slope under a bright blue sky with readable shadow sides; leaf cards are blobby up close and the valley floor is bare brown.
Noon meadow with oak groves and, new, a hazy snow-capped mountain ring closing the horizon; ridgelines are still faceted at distance and the hills are bare brown.
Late-afternoon view across the vale to layered ranges and snowy peaks; the foreground grass sits in deep shadow and the peaks form a uniform sawtooth.
A rook flock feeding on cropped turf in the vale at 14:00; reads as a real field, but the crop patch shows bare brown ground and the birds are tiny at 15 m.
Rooks bursting up out of the meadow as the camera comes within 10 m; motion reads in a clip, but the still is small dark specks and the shaded hillside is muddy.
The player is now a rigged, animated human instead of a capsule, standing in the afternoon meadow; still wrong: sci-fi armour and visor instead of a mythic hero, no face, hair or staff.
Follow camera on the player mid-stride in the idle/walk/run blend at dusk, lantern glow on the grass; still wrong: placeholder Mixamo soldier model and no foot IK.

Close rear view of the hero's new procedural staff slung across the back: worn bronze caps, red lacquered shaft, hemp-wrapped grip; still wrong: it is strapped to a sci-fi armoured soldier with no strap or scabbard holding it.
The hero seen from behind against a low sun, staff diagonal across the back at body scale; still wrong: placeholder Mixamo soldier model, flat cartoonish far mountains.
Overhead-slam wind-up: both hands IK-locked on the staff raised over the head, chest twisted into the swing; still wrong: sci-fi soldier model, legs stay in idle, harsh red ground under the grass.
Mid-sweep of the light string with a faint pale swing trail; still wrong: the two-handed grip reads like holding a rifle at this angle, trail too faint, placeholder soldier model.

Overhead slam frozen 5 ticks after it lands on the practice post's iron-capped top: dust burst, flying chaff and the swing arc read as a hit; still wrong: placeholder sci-fi soldier, dust a little too bright, tall grass hides the feet.
Opening sweep connecting with the straw-bound oak practice post; still wrong: the chaff is too small to read at this distance and the staff is hidden behind the body, placeholder model.
Close look at the new practice post (weathered oak, straw bundle, hemp lashings, rusted iron band) backlit at 10 h; straw and rope read well, the shaded oak top goes near-black and looks too smooth.

The new dash-step dodge frozen early: the hero sinks low and leans hard into the dash past the practice post, vitality bar with its pale lost segment bottom-left; still the sci-fi placeholder model and no real roll clip.

Later in the dodge with the reworked HUD: thin red vitality bar over a pale-gold stamina bar, both readable over bright grass; the pose reads as a running lean rather than a Wukong dodge, and the model is a placeholder.

Hollow Soldier at the peak of its wind-up: grey ash-stone body with the ember flaring in the chest and a glint on the spear blade as the tell; still fails — the sci-fi armour silhouette shows under the ash and the backlit foreground grass is blown out.

Side-on as the soldier's lunging thrust lands on the hero at the practice post; the thrust reads as a body lunge but the spear is hidden along the view line, and both models are placeholder sci-fi soldiers.

Lock-on: the follow camera slides over the right shoulder to frame the hero and the Hollow Soldier mid wind-up, with the bone-white reticle on its chest; still wrong: sci-fi placeholder bodies, over-bright foreground grass, steep framing shows too much ground.

Parry: the hero raises the staff into the heavy just as the Hollow Soldier's thrust lands, a spark burst throws the spear aside; still wrong: sci-fi placeholder bodies, the spark reads as a soft orange blob, foreground grass blades are flat and glaring.

Tier-2 heavy smash driving the staff into the meadow; still wrong: the slam dust is a grey sphere, a stray glint cloud hangs in the sky, the staggered soldier is missing from the frame (shot tool), placeholder hero body.

First light sweep connecting with the practice post: the staff now travels flat at shoulder height as authored instead of lying sideways; still wrong: placeholder sci-fi hero body, the post blocks the hero in this camera, bare red soil between grass clumps.
Overhead strike coming down on the centre line with a long grip (vertical trail behind the post); still wrong: camera puts the post in front of the hero, placeholder body, flat foreground grass.
Hollow Soldier coiling its new sweep: spear wound flat behind its right side, chest ember flaring; still placeholder sci-fi bodies and faceted far ridges.
The sweep mid-arc cutting flat through the hero at waist height; no spear swing trail yet, bodies are still the sci-fi placeholder.

Night meadow at 21:30: fireflies drift and blink over the grass, the brightest few lighting the blades green around them; the hero is still the sci-fi placeholder and the far ridges glow brighter than the night sky.
Low evening sun through the oak grove with a midge swarm glinting beside the trunk; the glints are subtle (a few px), canopy leaf cards are still large and flat.

Night meadow at 22:00 with fireflies: the moonlit haze now continues into the sky so the far ridges sit as soft layered silhouettes under the stars instead of a glowing blue cut-out; ridges are still faceted and the grass blades read coarse up close.

Hero by the practice post at 21:30, lit only by the moon and fireflies now that the sourceless orange 'lantern' pool is gone; the hero is still the sci-fi placeholder and the tree canopies blow out under the moon haze.

18:12, looking west over the meadow: the sky now holds a warm afterglow behind the silhouetted ridges after sunset instead of going black; the ridges are still faceted and the foreground grass is near-black.
18:36 blue hour: the glow cools to violet-blue over the horizon as stars appear; the stars switch on all at once, too dense and gold-tinted for this early in the dusk.

18:24 toward the sunset: afterglow behind the peaks under a violet sky, and the meadow and oaks now lit by the twilight instead of black; the valley floor is too saturated rose-red and the canopies are still leaf cards.
17:45 toward the sun: the low sun now lights the meadow a warm gold instead of an orange-red wash, with long oak shadows; still fails on faceted far ridges and leaf-card canopies.
18:24 twilight: the valley floor now sits in a dusty mauve afterglow instead of saturated rose-red, ridges layered in haze; fails on faceted ridges, near-black canopies and coarse foreground grass.
Hero rocks back from a spear thrust that broke the heavy charge, staff thrown wide, impact dust; the soldier is missing from the frame (known shot bug), hero small in frame, ridges still faceted.
Pre-dawn at 5.6 h: mauve glow behind the eastern ridges, mist in the oak valley, blue sky to the west; a dark rock edge clips the left of frame and ridges are faceted.
The hero 0.6 s after a killing blow, knees buckled with the staff still gripped low; framed far left, soldier missing from the frame (shot bug), Vanguard armour and faceted ridges.
The fallen hero lying face-down in the amber grass before the screen fades to black; reads as a body, but the pose is a rigid plank and the sci-fi armour is still the model.

Half a second after a killing blow the hero's knees fold onto the grass (bone-level bend, legs no longer sink into the ground), chest curled, one arm out; still the sci-fi Vanguard armour, coarse near grass.
The hero lying face-down with legs extended and head turned, staff dropped in the grass; reads as a fallen body, but the grass does not flatten under it and the armour is not mythic.

The Hollow Soldier now wears a deep hood with a dark face void, a ragged shoulder mantle, a sash and a torn tabard to the knees, the ember glowing through the open chest; the silhouette reads as a cloaked revenant, but it is backlit and the legs still show the old armour greaves.
Side view of the rags in daylight: woven hemp hood, mantle and sash over the ash body; the cloth is still a uniform charcoal and the tabards hang stiff as boards rather than draping.

Close look at the Hollow Soldier's legs (grass hidden): the old greaves are now bound in wound hemp bandages fitted to the armour, but the wraps still read bulky and barrel-shaped and the boots show below.

Side view in daylight: hood, mantle, sash and the new shin wraps hide most of the sci-fi armour; the shins look padded rather than bound and the ember cracks on the thighs still read as armour plates.
Hollow Soldier legs now bound in hemp: thigh, shin and boot wraps hide the old armour; the wraps are too thick and the boot wrap is a lump.
Side view of the Hollow Soldier in the meadow: hood, mantle, tabards and bandaged limbs read as one revenant, but the silhouette is padded and bulky.

Macro shot with depth of field of a small tortoiseshell basking on the meadow at 11 h; reads as a butterfly, but it hovers on no grass stem, its pattern washes out in the warm grade, and the near grass blades are flat ribbons over bare brown soil.
A peacock butterfly settled over the 14 h meadow from half a metre; too small to read its eyes at this range, and the clumped grass over bare brown ground looks like a prototype.
A buttercup drift speckles the 10:30 meadow with yellow heads above the wind-bent grass; the black soil under the grass and flat blade ribbons still look like a prototype.
Knapweed, ox-eye daisies and yarrow mixed through the 15 h meadow beside the hero and the Hollow Soldier; flowers read, but bare brown soil between grass clumps dominates.
A small tortoiseshell settled on a yarrow umbel (perching on real flowers now, not air); the umbel was too sparse here and was densified after, and the ground is black.

Knee-height across a buttercup drift: the ground between the clumps is now lit turf with lying blades instead of a black void; the blade stroke pattern repeats like tread plate at grazing angles and the grass ribbons are still flat.
Looking down at the meadow floor: straw-strewn sward, moss and clover between the clumps reads as real ground; clump shadows are still very dark and the clumps too regular.
Afternoon valley from a hillside: the turf floor holds up at distance with no shimmer; the backlit tree crowns blow out white and the far peaks are faceted.
A rain front over the valley at noon: grey overcast light, rain streaks, wind-combed grass, the far ridges lost in rain haze; the sky is a flat grey with no cloud forms and the ridges are faceted.
The hero in the meadow in the rain: soaked, darkened grass bent by gusts and streaks falling; the hero is still the sci-fi placeholder and no splashes or puddles show on the ground.
